name: com.unialgames.keytween
description: Keyframe UI animation for uGUI: animations live in the prefab, authored as keys in a dedicated editor with live preview, recording and per-prefab overrides. Tween-level performance, text effects, scroll lists and screen transitions.

samples.description: A mobile RPG UI built only with KeyTween states: lobby, heroes, bag, summon, adventure, battle, quests, shop, guild and more. Open Scenes/RPG.unity. Needs the Input System package.
Buttons, hover effects, toggles, a popup, text effects and 18 scroll list examples, each a prefab with its states. Open a scene in Scenes/. Needs the Input System package.
